name: ema200_dip_reversal_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY dips to its 60-minute EMA — a major intraday reference level explicitly tracked by index futures desks, VWAP-algo overlays, and delta-hedging market makers — resting buy orders cluster just above this EMA because systematic programs treat it as a 'buy zone' for intraday mean reversion. Each time NIFTY touches this level and holds, the absorption becomes faster as confirmation builds across desks; at 5-second resolution we can detect the first recovery bar (positive 5s return) the moment price re-crosses above the EMA touch zone, entering CE options before the broader 1-minute bar even closes. The 60-minute EMA compresses the original multi-day EMA concept to an intraday one because at 5s resolution with 15-90s hold times we are capturing the institutional intraday reversion, not a multi-day trend recovery.
core_signal_oneliner: Price dips to and immediately bounces off the 60-minute EMA (720-bar at 5s), with the first positive 5s return bar as entry trigger
